Preferred windows (BST):
- Tue 15 Jun between 16:00–18:00
- Wed 16 Jun 17:00–19:00
- Thu 17 Jun 16:30–18:30

We can share the vendor onboarding form in advance. Let me know which slot works and whether Redwood needs any pre-reads.

Thanks,
